Lithofin MN Easy-Clean

Ready-to-use for all kitchen work tops.

Article number : 189
For every-day cleaning of small stone surfaces such as kitchen bench-tops, tabletops, bathroom vanity tops and wall tiles. Enhances the appearance of the stone and leaves a pleasant odour.
Product type: mildly alkaline cleaner
  • poses no health concerns once dry
  • cleans, protects and maintains
  • does not leave streaks
Technical data
Coverage approx. 40 m²/litre
Stocking Cool and closed. Not above 25°C; can be stored for up to 3 years
Packaging 500 ml | also available as 1 L refill package

FAQ
Does a granite kitchen counter top need any sort of special treatment?

At first glance, natural stone surfaces look dense and robust. However, the stone contains pores and capillaries, which allow dirt to penetrate the surface.
A protective treatment like Lithofin MN Stain-Stop (or Lithofin STAINSTOP >W<) makes the surface resistant to oil, grease and water borne dirt. Dirt does no longer penetrate the stone and is therefore simple to remove.
The protective treatment in combination with the right maintenance program will prevent staining. We recommend Lithofin MN Easy-Clean for daily cleaning.
